args.description: darts forward to the right: pushes off hard from the back foot and springs forward low with the torso leaning far forward, a long silver spear with white ribbons held low and trailing behind her in one hand, the free arm swept back, one long low stride, landing on the front foot already in a running stride. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young woman with very long silver hair, a blue ribbon and violet eyes, a closed high-collared black and white top, a long black coat, loose black shorts reaching her knees over fully opaque black tights from waist to ankle, black boots, holding a long silver spear with white ribbons
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a long silver spear with white ribbons
